statusDefinitions.Met: Attainment is at or above 100% of the target to date.
statusDefinitions.On Track: Attainment is between 90% and 99% of the target to date.
statusDefinitions.At Risk: Attainment is between 50% and 89% of the target to date.
statusDefinitions.Delayed: Attainment is above 0% but below 50% of the target to date.
statusDefinitions.Not Started: A target exists but no accomplishment has been recorded.
statusDefinitions.No Target: The indicator has no target to date, so attainment cannot be computed.
